I'm a self-taught engineer who has been building for the web since 2015 — through the Angular years, the JavaScript fatigue era, and a string of products for the Tunisian market. These days most of my time goes to running AI agents in production and writing here about what that actually takes, beyond the demo.

The archive below goes back a decade. I've kept all of it — the old posts are a record of how we got here.

Currently — shipping code with AI agents at Nuraly · building Lumen, a TypeScript-syntax language written in Zig
